title: Wait for the agent notification in drain without a watcher

rubric.text: Does not start a watcher: no PR is in remote wait and nothing is waiting on a human, so there is no remote or human-gated state to watch.
Does not poll, sleep, use ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, or /loop, and does not run the single-PR host monitor.
Waits for the due agent completion notification, then continues the normal drain scheduling and refresh rules.
Performs no commands, provider calls, or edits in this supplied-state scenario.
